package.description: Light but Powerful File Recovery Tool

en-US.description: Light but Powerful File Recovery Tool
en-US.longDescription: IObit Undelete is a free software tool designed to recover deleted and lost files with just a few clicks. It supports various file types, including documents, videos, graphics, and music. The software offers both target and deep scans to detect and retrieve lost data, even from inaccessible or hidden locations.
en-US.name: IObit Undelete
